section_summary.extract_value: This section details the analytical approach for the current study, which involved Poisson regression for CAQ scores due to their skewed distribution, consistent with prior research. It also employed moderated multiple regression to examine interactions between quadratic intelligence and linear personality terms, controlling for age and gender. The analyses were conducted on both a full sample and a reduced sample (excluding individuals below the median) to ensure the robustness of findings, particularly concerning creative achievement in the arts and sciences.
